validity: Published source viability values, RNA identities and primary other-cancer controls are traceable. They do not authenticate EMC ferroptosis or direct metabolic dependence.
value: No new publication-worthy empirical EMC comparison survives. Complete source/name auditing and preserved uncertainty are reusable work, rather than discoveries. Failure of an untested ferroptosis speculation is not an important negative biological finding.
strongest_alternative: Any sorafenib or redox-adjacent viability effect could reflect kinase activity, formulation, media, exposure differences or general cytotoxicity. Other-sarcoma rescue data cannot resolve EMC.
reopen: Authenticated EMC donor/model and condition maps with matched GPX4/xCT or cystine perturbation, lipid-peroxidation/iron measurements, mechanistic rescue and suitable controls; evaluate all relevant public EMC conditions and obtain an independent scientific-value challenge. Existing bulk RNA alone cannot rescue this question.
remaining_questions: Full broad CTRP model crosswalk, MRI/ascorbate histology and source access, generic organoid/model and individual pharmacodynamic crosswalks; none assumed negative or exhausted.
raw_portability: Full primary sources, catalogue responses and full paragraph derivatives remain ignored and preserved. URLs, hashes and relevant extracted rows are exported. Shared full sources were not copied; fresh reproduction may require permitted URL/hash recovery.
scientific_fate: No manuscript, efficacy or safety claim, clinical recommendation or target ranking. Continue credible source-backed questions. TMEM266 remains shelved.
